div.l: He was a verray . ꝑperfit practisour .
¶ The cause knowe . ⁊and of his harme þe rote .
A noon he yaf . the seke man his bote .
Full redy had he . his apothecaries .
To sende hym his dregges . ⁊and his letuaries .
For eche of hem . made other for to wynne .
Here frendschipe . nas nought newe to begynne .
Well knewe he . the olde Esculapius .
And Diascorides . ⁊and eke Rufus .
Olde ypocras . Haly . ⁊and Galien.
Serapioūn . Razie . ⁊and Auycen .
Auerois . Damascien . ⁊and Constantyn .
Bernard . ⁊and Gatesden . ⁊and Gilbertyn .
Of his diete . mesurable was he .
For yt was . of no superfluyte .
But of gret norischyng . ⁊and digestible .
His studie . was not but litell in the bible .
In sangwyn . ⁊and in perse . he clad was all .
Lyned with taffata . ⁊and with sendall .
And yet he was . but esie of dispense .
He kepte . that he wan in pestilense .
For gold in Phisik . is a cordiall .
There fore he loued gold . in speciall .
A Good wif ther was . of beside bathe .
But sche was somdell deef . ⁊and þtat was scathe .
Of cloth makyng . sche had suche an haunt .
Sche passid hem of ypris ⁊and of Gaunt .
In all the parisch wif ne was ther noon .
That to offryng . bifore here schulde goon .
And if ther did certeyn . so wroth was sche .
That sche was oute . of all charite .
Hir couerchiefs . full fyne were of groūnde .
I durste swere . thei weied ten poūnde .
That vp on a sondaye . were vp on here heed .
Hir / hosyn . were of fyne scarlet reed .
Full streyt tyed . ⁊and schoos full moiste ⁊and newe .
Bolde was hir face . ⁊and faire ⁊and reed of hewe .
Sche was a worthi woman . all hir lyue .
Husbondes atte chirche dore . had sche had fyue .
With oute other companye . in youthe .
But herof nedeth noght . for to speke as nowthe .
And thries had sche ben . at Ierusalem .
Sche had passed . many a straunge streem .
At Rome had sche ben . ⁊and at Boloyne .
In Galice at seynt Iame . ⁊and at Coloyne .
Sche couthe moche . of wrandryng by the weie .
Greed tothed was sche . sothly for to seie .
